balance_status: Proposed untested starting values; primary/alternate prose is design, not implemented combat.

weapons.name: Vesper
weapons.primary: Accurate semi-auto flechette; 24 damage, 4 shots/s
weapons.alternate: Three-round fan; 3 x 15 damage, 0.7 s recovery
weapons.counterplay: Weak against armor; fan loses range

weapons.name: Ossuary
weapons.primary: Six-shot hand cannon; 68 damage, 1.2 shots/s
weapons.alternate: Piercing charged shot; 95 damage, consumes two rounds
weapons.counterplay: Charge whistle and slow follow-up

weapons.name: Needle Choir
weapons.primary: 18 microdarts/s, 7 damage each; climbs with heat
weapons.alternate: Six-dart tight burst; 0.35 s pause
weapons.counterplay: Short reach and exposure while spraying

weapons.name: Rivet Saint
weapons.primary: Heavy rivets, 32 damage, 5 shots/s
weapons.alternate: Pinning rivet slows for 0.6 s; 2 ammo
weapons.counterplay: Slow visible projectiles can be dodged

weapons.name: Grave Bell
weapons.primary: Two-barrel shotgun; 10 x 11 damage, 0.9 shots/s
weapons.alternate: Both barrels; 20 x 9 damage with strong self recoil
weapons.counterplay: Low effective range; break-action reload

weapons.name: Cerberus
weapons.primary: Three-barrel sequential buckshot; 8 x 10 damage
weapons.alternate: Triple blast; 24 x 9 damage, 1.8 s recovery
weapons.counterplay: Three-shell reload leaves an opening

weapons.name: Reliquary
weapons.primary: Pump shotgun; 12 x 9 damage, 1 shot/s
weapons.alternate: Tight slug; 85 damage, 1.1 s recovery
weapons.counterplay: Pump tells enemies when to advance

weapons.name: Furnace Organ
weapons.primary: Six-barrel minigun; 20 x 8 damage/s after spin-up
weapons.alternate: Brake rotor and fire wide 12-pellet burst
weapons.counterplay: 0.65 s spin-up; heat forces venting

weapons.name: Hailstorm
weapons.primary: Twin rotary banks; 24 x 9 damage/s
weapons.alternate: Anchor stance halves spread, reduces movement
weapons.counterplay: Heavy and conspicuous; must cool after sustained fire

weapons.name: Cautery
weapons.primary: Instant red laser pulse; 42 damage, 3 shots/s
weapons.alternate: Continuous cutting beam; 85 damage/s, heat limited
weapons.counterplay: Beam traces expose position; poor burst

weapons.name: Prism Writ
weapons.primary: Three split laser rays; 3 x 22 damage
weapons.alternate: Focus all prisms; 100 damage after 0.8 s charge
weapons.counterplay: Prongs expose charge state; cover breaks line of sight

weapons.name: Longwake
weapons.primary: Rail shot; 125 damage, 1.4 s cooldown, pierces one target
weapons.alternate: Zoomed low-power shot; 78 damage, 0.7 s cooldown
weapons.counterplay: Bright charge and long trail reveal sniper

weapons.name: Ion Psalm
weapons.primary: Large plasma bolts; 38 damage, 5 shots/s
weapons.alternate: Slow plasma orb; 110 radial damage, 4 ammo
weapons.counterplay: Orbs are visible and can be outrun

weapons.name: Sun Eater
weapons.primary: Short-range beam; 150 damage/s, ramps over 0.6 s
weapons.alternate: Overload lance; 200 damage, 2 s charge, entire core
weapons.counterplay: Long vent and obvious glow after overload

weapons.name: Storm Rosary
weapons.primary: Chain lightning; 48 first hit, 0.7 falloff, 3 jumps
weapons.alternate: Conductive anchor orb; chains near impact for 3 s
weapons.counterplay: 8 m link limit; cover and spacing break chains

weapons.name: Forked Benediction
weapons.primary: Twin direct arcs; 2 x 28 damage, 5 pulses/s
weapons.alternate: Ground fork creates 2 s electrical tripline
weapons.counterplay: Cannot chain through walls; visible ground tells

weapons.name: Ball Lightning
weapons.primary: Slow seeking orb; 75 damage, 5 s lifetime
weapons.alternate: Detonate orb early; 110 radial damage
weapons.counterplay: Shootable orb and broad electric sound

weapons.name: Thunder Loom
weapons.primary: Rotating arc stream; 95 damage/s with 2 chain jumps
weapons.alternate: Discharge all heat into a 4 m pulse, 80 damage
weapons.counterplay: Danger at close range but ineffective across open lanes

weapons.name: Pilgrim
weapons.primary: Straight rocket; 105 direct + 70 splash damage
weapons.alternate: Hold three rockets for a staggered salvo
weapons.counterplay: Self splash; charge creates audible lock rattle

weapons.name: Widow Choir
weapons.primary: Four micro-missiles; 4 x 32 direct damage
weapons.alternate: Paint target for 0.8 s then limited-turn homing volley
weapons.counterplay: Lock warning; obstacles and sharp turns defeat guidance

weapons.name: Basilisk
weapons.primary: Heavy rocket; 150 direct + 110 radial damage
weapons.alternate: Airburst at sighted range; 18 x 10 fragments
weapons.counterplay: Slow reload and visible flight; fragments respect walls

weapons.name: Censer
weapons.primary: Bouncing grenade; 100 damage, 1.8 s fuse, 3 bounces
weapons.alternate: Sticky grenade; 80 damage with manual detonation
weapons.counterplay: Grenade glow and audible bounce; owner splash

weapons.name: Vigil Mortar
weapons.primary: Arcing mortar; 130 radial damage, 2.4 s flight cap
weapons.alternate: Low lob cluster; 5 x 38 damage bomblets
weapons.counterplay: Ground marker for 0.7 s; roof and cover block blast

weapons.name: Cathedral
weapons.primary: Deploy braces and lob siege shell; 220 damage, 4 s cycle
weapons.alternate: Smoke shell hides an 8 m lane for 6 s
weapons.counterplay: Immobile while braced; smoke also obscures owner

weapons.name: Shrapnel Mass
weapons.primary: Direct hot fragments; 14 x 10 damage
weapons.alternate: Lob flak shell; 90 radial damage and short-lived shards
weapons.counterplay: Falls off fast; shards have one bounce and 0.6 s life

weapons.name: Ricochet Gospel
weapons.primary: Saw disc; 65 damage, 3 predictable wall bounces
weapons.alternate: Recall disc; 45 return damage, 1 hit per target per leg
weapons.counterplay: Owner can be struck; bright trajectory ribbon

weapons.name: Bankshot
weapons.primary: Elastic bolt; 50 damage, gains 15 on first wall bounce
weapons.alternate: Three-bolt bank fan; 3 x 32 damage
weapons.counterplay: Maximum 4 bounces / 3 s; sharp bounce sound

weapons.name: Scrap Cyclone
weapons.primary: Scrap cone; 18 x 8 damage, consumes 4 scrap
weapons.alternate: Magnet charge and release penetrator; 115 damage
weapons.counterplay: Charged scrap is loud; cannot consume quest items

weapons.name: Miasma
weapons.primary: Corrosive glob; 28 direct + 36 over 3 s
weapons.alternate: Lob gel puddle; 25 damage/s for 4 s in 2 m radius
weapons.counterplay: Distinct green puddles; burn damage never stacks indefinitely

weapons.name: Winter Verdict
weapons.primary: Cryo spray; 55 damage/s, caps slow at 25 percent
weapons.alternate: Ice lance; 80 damage, shatters own chilled targets for +30
weapons.counterplay: Short spray range; no hard stun or input lock

weapons.name: Eventide
weapons.primary: Gravity slug; 60 direct damage with slight lateral pull
weapons.alternate: 2 s vortex pulls projectiles within 3 m; 120 damage cap
weapons.counterplay: Visible warmup; never pulls players through cover

weapons.name: Veilbreaker
weapons.primary: Rare superweapon; 240 damage implosion in 5 m after 1 s
weapons.alternate: Focused 180 damage lance without radial pull
weapons.counterplay: Loud global cue, 2.5 s windup, one-core magazine
